seo_title: Cross-Device SEO Attribution: Save Your B2B Budget
seo_desc: Discover how cross-device SEO analytics recovers the B2B sales you thought were lost between mobile searches and desktop conversions.
author_pitch: As an SEO strategist and digital analytics specialist, I've seen hundreds of B2B companies shut down profitable campaigns because their data was blind. I build analytical bridges where others see conversion black holes.
title: The Fragmented Funnel: Why Your SEO Analytics Hides Your High-Ticket Sales
body:
Are your SEO campaigns attracting thousands of mobile clicks but conversions only arrive from branded desktop searches?

You are losing money due to a distorted analytical vision. B2B buyers and high-ticket clients discover you on their phones while commuting, but they pull out their credit card or request a quote days later from their office computer. If you do not connect these two events, your team will think mobile SEO does not work, cut investment in informational keywords, and destroy the top of your organic sales funnel.

The Trap of Last-Click Attribution

Google Analytics by default assigns merit to the last interaction, making transactional SEO look like a useless expense when the user switches devices. Uncorrelated data is the silent killer of your digital profitability.

Our Solution: Comprehensive Cross-Device Traceability

At LANZA ESTUDIO we apply advanced analytics and data-driven attribution modeling to reconstruct the complete user journey. We identify the true value of every SEO keyword, from mobile discovery to desktop closing, ensuring you invest exactly where the return is generated.

  1. User-ID Implementation: We configure persistent identification ecosystems to track real users, not isolated cookies.
  2. Data Flow Unification: We connect your CRM with web analytics tools to close the loop between organic clicks and final sales.
  3. Algorithmic Attribution Modeling: We abandon the last-click model to assign the exact monetary value to each page of your SEO funnel.
  4. Conversion Leak Auditing: We detect where the experience breaks between mobile and desktop to apply technical CRO improvements.

The Real Impact on B2B Profitability

  • Absolute visibility of organic ROI: You discover which informational keywords are generating silent sales.
  • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) reduction: By optimizing the pages that initiate the customer journey, you increase the total volume of qualified leads.
  • Decisions based on reality, not mirages: You scale your SEO strategy with the technical certainty that every invested euro has a measurable return.
